text.tspan: Figure 1 Firing-rate distributions, population timing, and cue modulation
Complete 80-trial reconstruction using a 5 s baseline, a 20 s post-cue analysis period, and the predefined unmodulated cohort for the one-SD response rule.
Rates are shown as unit density per Hz, preserving the 2 Hz bins below 20 Hz and wider bins in the sparse tail.
Cue-aligned population activity and one-SD response classes
The heatmaps show baseline z-scored activity sorted by peak latency. Lower panels show class means, an unmodulated mean +/- 1 SD band, and excited/suppressed mean +/- SEM.
Cue modulation versus 0-20 s firing rate
Raw points are classified against the predefined unmodulated cohort mean +/- 1 SD. Curves are adaptive-bin medians; bins with fewer than five units are omitted.
